## Triage: first grade, `enhancement` · `priority:p1` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, `pm:blocked` on the two spec cards

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T18:51Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23004
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23005

- **Why p1:** this is the renderer half of two p1 walls under objectstack-ai/cloud#2776 (p1, the maintainer's). A wall inherits the level (`filing-gate.md:42`).
- **Direction, the card's own two items:**
  - `ListView`'s empty branch draws the declared link through the runner's navigation (`classifyNavigationTarget`). ⛔ No second URL check.
  - `InterfaceListPage` prefers the page's own `emptyState` over a source view's, on every visualization.
  - The key names are read from the spec version that carries them, ⛔ not from this card.
- **Unlock:** both spec cards landed, and a `@objectstack/spec` this repository can install that carries them.
- **Delivery:** reaches cloud with objectstack-ai/cloud#2709.
- Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-list` and `packages/app-shell` (`domain:ui`); rationale: the renderer half of a spec door.

Scope addition from objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 · session `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ` · 2026-10-12T21:07Z. The spec half is implemented as PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23098 (accepted, contract review pending). It names the keys `emptyState.link: { label, url }` and `interfaceConfig.emptyState`.

The link widens a **third door** this card did not name. `EmptyStateSchema` is taken by reference by the `object-grid` page block too (`ComponentPropsMap['object-grid'].emptyState`), and that block is drawn by:

3. **`packages/plugin-grid` `ObjectGrid.tsx`**, near L6647–6655 at objectui `7af0ab3`. It reads `emptyState.title` / `message` / `icon` only. Draw the declared link there through the same navigation answer as `ListView`.

When this card lands, the spec side owes a follow-up: drop the two `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` markers, rewrite the two ledger notes, offer `interfaceConfig.emptyState` in the page form, and delete its reconciliation omit row. A `domain:spec` card is filed then.

## Unlock scan: `pm:blocked` → `pm:on-hold` (upstream merged, not yet installable) · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z` · 2026-10-13T00:44Z

Both blockers closed `completed`, and this card itself says it waits "then on a spec release this repository can install". That release does not exist yet, so the card moves to `pm:on-hold` with the restart line below, ⛔ not back to `pm:queue`. It is unassigned and unclaimed, so there is nothing to release.

- **Blockers:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#23004 and #23005 closed at 2026-10-12T22:24Z by PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23098 (merge `55828c5145`). It adds `EmptyStateSchema.link: { label, url }` and `InterfacePageConfigSchema.emptyState`, as the scope addition `6132635356` above names them.
- **Not installable here:**
  - objectui consumes `@objectstack/spec` as a published package. npm `latest` is `17.7.0`.
  - REST compare reads `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0...55828c5145` as `ahead` 567, `behind` 0, so the merge is not in the tag.
- **Negative control, run against `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0` installed alone:** the probe below exits 1. `EmptyStateSchema` refuses `link` as an unrecognised key, and `InterfacePageConfigSchema` refuses `emptyState`.

Restart-when: an `@objectstack/spec` release carrying objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #23098 (`55828c5145`) is published on npm and objectui resolves it: from `apps/console`, `node -e "import('@objectstack/spec/ui').then(m=>process.exit(m.EmptyStateSchema.safeParse({link:{label:'Add',url:'/apps/x'}}).success&&m.InterfacePageConfigSchema.safeParse({emptyState:{}}).success?0:1))"` exits 0.

**On restart:** the renderer work is the three doors this card and its scope addition name:
1. `ListView`'s empty branch.
2. `InterfaceListPage` preferring the page's own `interfaceConfig.emptyState`.
3. `ObjectGrid`'s empty state.

Each link is drawn through the action runner's navigation (`classifyNavigationTarget`), ⛔ never a scheme list of its own. Re-measure the line anchors at that time. Triage's `priority:p1` (`6130578798`) stands.

2. `InterfaceListPage` prefers the page's own `interfaceConfig.emptyState` over its source view's, on every visualization.

Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: the renderers start honouring two newly declared keys (`emptyState.link`, `interfaceConfig.emptyState`), which widens what they accept. A contract review is owed before the queue.
Responsibility: `@object-ui/plugin-list, @object-ui/plugin-grid and @object-ui/app-shell (a declared empty-state link and a list page's own emptyState are not rendered) | none | every cloud console empty page under objectstack-ai/cloud#2776 (p1)`
Thread-read: 6135494657
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-14T02:42Z on objectui `main` `c5406c2`. No open PR touches these files. objectui#11773 and #12192 are dispatched by this seat in the same round on disjoint surfaces.

## Landed: objectui PR #12350 → `main` `b434f5f` · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z` · 2026-10-14T05:01Z

- Merged through the merge queue at 2026-10-14T05:00Z, on parent `c08c9332a6`. This card closed `completed` by the PR's `Fixes #12270`, which is the body's only closing keyword.
- **Landed by content:** all 17 of the PR's files on `main` `b434f5f47e` are blob-identical to the accepted head `f20667b`.
  - ACCEPT: `6161097655`.
  - Contract review: `6161068462`, **PASS**, at opus under the maintainer's waiver `6160996883`.
- `pm:dispatched` was removed and read back.
- The changeset rides the next objectui release, `minor` for `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- **What is on `main`:**
  - An empty list (the `grid` and `gallery` visualizations) and the `object-grid` block's authored empty state draw the declared `emptyState.link`. It is followed as a `type: 'url'` action through the action runner, so `classifyNavigationTarget` decides what a click opens.
  - A list page's own `interfaceConfig.emptyState` wins whole over its source view's, on every visualization.
  - `@object-ui/components` exports `EmptyStateLink`.
- **For the spec seat:** the renderer half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23004 / #23005 has landed. The two `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` markers become true to drop once objectstack's console pin carries `b434f5f`. That hop is objectstack-ai/objectstack#23392, which is unassigned; this seat does not dispatch it (`6161143200`).
